p: Adullam: Which was in the tribe of Judah, near Bethlehem.
Moab: For there was another so called in Judah.
brought them before the king of: For he feared the rage of Saul against his house.
the hold: That is, in Mizpeh, which was a stronghold.
discovered: That a great brute came on him.
Benjamites: You that are of my tribe and lineage.
son hath stirred up my servant: By this he would persuade them that this conspiracy was most horrible, where the son conspired against the father, and the servant against his master.
the priests that were in Nob: Which were the remnant of the house of Eli, whose house God threatened to punish.
Did I then begin to enquire: Have I not at other times also, when he had great affairs, consulted with the Lord for him?
would not put forth their hand: For they knew that they should not obey the wicked commandment of the king in slaying the innocent.
escaped: This was God's providence, who according to his promise preserved some of the house of Eli, 1Sa 2:33.
